values: 制造香薰并持续恢复生命，主动使用可以升级香薰。
Smokey & Meerky create an aroma and provide continuous healing. Actively using the skill levels up the aroma.

战斗开始后，在自己周围2格范围内制造并持续施法维持香薰。香薰存在时，自身每秒回复50点能量，在香薰内的友军每秒回复-21% ATK生命值。主动使用时，立即为香薰内的友军回复 170% + 15% ATK生命值，并使香薰的效果永久升级。第一次升级效果：香薰的作用范围扩大1格。第二次升级效果：受影响的友军获得额外30点急速。被动地，当自身受到打断效果影响时，香薰将会中断，且后续4秒内自身将无法再制造香薰。

Smokey & Meerky create an aroma within 2 tiles and keep it going through channeling when a battle starts. While the aroma is around, Smokey & Meerky recover 50 Energy per second, and allies within the aroma recover -21% ATK HP per second.
Passive. If interrupted, Smokey & Meerky lose the aroma and cannot recreate it in 4s.
Active. Smokey & Meerky heal allies within the aroma by 170% + 15% ATK, and permanently level up the aroma's effects.
Improved Aroma I: Expand the range by 1 tile. 
Improved Aroma II: Grant 30 Haste to allied heroes affected by the aroma.
每秒生命回复量提高至-24% ATK。
Increase HP recovery per second to -24% ATK.
每秒生命回复量提高至-27% ATK。
Increase HP recovery per second to -27% ATK.
每秒生命回复量提高至-29% ATK。
Increase HP recovery per second to -29% ATK.
每秒生命回复量提高至-31% ATK。
Increase HP recovery per second to -31% ATK.
香薰内的友军提升攻击力，并为自己额外恢复能量。
Smokey & Meerky increase the ATK of allies within the aroma and recover Energy.
香薰内的友军提升16% + 1%攻击力。每个受影响的非召唤物友军，会使自身每秒额外回复5点能量。
Smokey & Meerky increase the ATK of allies within the aroma by 16% + 1%. Smokey & Meerky recover 5 additional Energy per second for every non-summoned ally affected.
香薰内的友军提升18% + 1%攻击力。
Increase the ATK of allies within the aroma by 18% + 1%.
每个受影响的非召唤物友军，会使自身每秒额外回复8点能量。
Recover 8 additional Energy per second for every non-summoned ally affected.
香薰内的友军提升20% + 1%攻击力。
Increase the ATK of allies within the aroma by 20% + 1%.
为香薰内的友军恢复生命。
Smokey & Meerky recover HP for allies within the aroma.
为香薰内的全体友军回复自身-90% − 10% ATK的生命值。
Smokey & Meerky recover -90% − 10% ATK HP for allies within the aroma.
提高自身攻击力，香薰内非召唤物友军数量不少于3个时进一步提升攻击力。
Smokey & Meerky increase their ATK, and the ATK bonus is further increased when there are 3 or more non-summoned allies within the aroma.
战斗中，自身提高6%攻击力。当香薰内除自身以外的非召唤物友军数量不少于3个时，自身额外提升9%攻击力。
Smokey & Meerky increase their ATK by 6% during battle. If 3 or more non-summoned allies other than Smokey & Meerky are within the aroma, they increase their ATK by an additional 9%.
战斗中，自身提高8%攻击力。当香薰内除自身以外的非召唤物友军数量不少于3个时，自身额外提升12%攻击力。
Smokey & Meerky increase their ATK by 8% during battle. If 3 or more non-summoned allies other than Smokey & Meerky are within the aroma, they increase their ATK by an additional 12%.
战斗中，自身提高10%攻击力。当香薰内除自身以外的非召唤物友军数量不少于3个时，自身额外提升15%攻击力。
Smokey & Meerky increase their ATK by 10% during battle. If 3 or more non-summoned allies other than Smokey & Meerky are within the aroma, they increase their ATK by an additional 15%.
香薰可以额外升级一次。满级后可对敌人造成伤害。
Smokey & Meerky gains Improved Aroma III, dealing more damage to enemies.
技能“特制香薰”获得第三次升级效果：香薰的作用范围额外扩大1格。在“特制香薰”首次获得第三次升级时，香薰将会获得持续10秒的强化，每秒使香薰内的敌人流失12%最大生命值，这部分生命流失量最高不超过自身200%攻击力。

Smokey & Meerky's Special Aroma gains the third level up effect, increasing the skill effect range by 1 tile. The aroma will be enhanced for 10s when this skill gets the third upgrade for the first time, making the enemies within skill range lose 12% of their max HP per second. The max amount of their lost HP cannot exceed 200% of Smokey & Meerky's ATK.
香薰强化期间，每秒使敌人流失的最大生命值比例提高至14%。
Make enemies within skill range lose 14% of their max HP during aroma enhancement.
香薰强化期间，每次使敌人流失生命时，还会将其眩晕0.1秒。
Stun the enemy for 0.1s during aroma enhancement when the enemy is losing HP.
香薰强化期间，每秒使敌人流失的最大生命值比例提高至15%。
Make enemies within skill range lose 15% of their max HP during aroma enhancement.
技能“特制香薰”主动使用时的生命回复量提高。
Smokey & Meerky use Special Aroma to recover more HP.
技能“特制香薰”主动使用时的生命回复量额外提高30% ATK 。
Smokey & Meerky increase the HP recovery amount by 30% ATK when using Special Aroma.
